architecture.ui: WPF + Wpf.Ui (Fluent Design / Dark Theme / Acrylic Glassmorphism)

subsystems.ClipboardMonitor: Services/ClipboardMonitor.cs (HwndSource message hook, 5x lock retry, suppression scope for internal writes)
subsystems.DataTypeDetector: Services/DataTypeDetector.cs (Image -> HexColor -> JSON -> URL -> Code -> PlainText pipeline)
subsystems.FlyoutWindowManager: Services/FlyoutWindowManager.cs (3.5s auto-dismiss, hover pause, 1.5s leave countdown, multi-monitor right-bottom placement)
subsystems.TrayIconService: Services/TrayIconService.cs (Background residency, enable/disable toggle, dynamic i18n language switcher, exit)
subsystems.LocalizationService: Services/LocalizationService.cs (Auto/Ja/En i18n dictionary for all UI text & actions)

Json.pattern: Trimmed starts with { or [ and ends with } or ], validated via JsonDocument.Parse

Code.pattern: Code keywords regex / braces / semicolons / indentation heuristics

PlainText.pattern: Fallback for all other string content
